_readme: Single source of truth for the operator (Anbieter) identity shown on /impressum, /privacy, /terms and /widerruf. Replace one value here and every legal page follows. value: null = still missing (a clearly marked placeholder is rendered); notApplicable: 'reason' = legally not applicable for this operator (row omitted, reason kept for the audit); requirement: mandatory = blocks a complete identity, conditional = depends on the legal form (documented in condition), optional = published only when provided. Never paste a bracketed placeholder into value: scripts/check-operator-identity.mjs rejects it.

legalForm.condition: Only for a registered legal form (e.g. GmbH, UG, AG); a sole trader has none.

registerCourt.condition: Only when the operator is entered in a register (Handels-, Partnerschafts- or Genossenschaftsregister).

registerNumber.condition: Only when the operator is entered in a register (Handels-, Partnerschafts- or Genossenschaftsregister).

vatId.condition: Only when a USt-IdNr. exists; a small business under § 19 UStG may not have one.

editorialResponsible.condition: Only when editorial content is offered (§ 18 (2) MStV) — the planned blog counts.

supervisoryAuthority.condition: Only for a regulated profession (chamber, professional title, supervisory authority).

dataProtectionOfficer.condition: Only when a DPO has to be appointed — still to be assessed.
